name: Frame injection (PC stream)
description: Adds the injection half of the display hook: reads /data/local/tmp/fb_shared and pushes those frames to the goggles display. Used by the PC-stream feature.
notes: Supersedes the capture-only hook (same source, larger build). Installing it restarts the goggles UI. While fb_override exists the display shows whatever the PC sends; remove fb_override or create fb_stop to return to the live UI. If the screen stays black, use Recover stock UI or reboot.
